title: Renewed violence in Palestine
summary: In 1936, violence broke out in Palestine and continued for three consecutive years. In Bendin, residents protested British policies; some demonstrators later caused damage at the British consulate in Katowice before police dispersed them.
uncertaintyNote: The text describes violence but does not identify it as a specific raid or operation.
